tests.name: bon8_strict_false_unterminated_string
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with strict=false on a BON8 string missing 0xFF and followed by another byte.

tests.name: bon8_strict_true_unterminated_string
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with strict=true on an unterminated BON8 string.

tests.name: bon8_strict_false_terminated_string
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with strict=false on a correctly terminated BON8 string with 0xFF.

tests.name: bon8_multibyte_unterminated_pushback
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with strict=false where an unterminated string pushes back multiple bytes.

tests.name: bon8_allow_exceptions_false
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with allow_exceptions=false on an unterminated string under strict=false.

tests.name: bon8_stream_input_unterminated
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 using an istringstream input with an unterminated string and strict=false.

tests.name: bon8_stream_input_terminated
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 using an istringstream input with a properly terminated string and subsequent read.

tests.name: bon8_pure_string_no_following_bytes
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with strict=false on a string that ends the input completely without 0xFF.

tests.name: bon8_to_bon8_roundtrip
tests.intent: Probes to_bon8 and from_bon8 roundtrip to verify canonical output behavior.

tests.name: bon8_non_string_value_trailing
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with strict=false on an integer value followed by extra bytes.

tests.name: bon8_non_string_value_strict_false
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with strict=false on an integer value without trailing bytes.

tests.name: bon8_empty_input
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with strict=false on an empty input vector.

tests.name: bon8_nested_array_with_unterminated_string
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 inside an array where a string lacks 0xFF termination.

tests.name: bon8_nested_object_with_unterminated_string
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 inside an object where a string value lacks 0xFF termination.

tests.name: bon8_string_followed_by_zero_byte
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with strict=false where the byte following an unterminated string is zero.

tests.name: bon8_multiple_strings_chained
tests.intent: Probes sequential parsing of BON8 values from a stream with strict=false.

tests.name: bon8_span_input_adapter_unterminated
tests.intent: Probes span_input_adapter directly with from_bon8 on an unterminated string and strict=false.

tests.name: bon8_sax_parse_direct
tests.intent: Probes basic_json::sax_parse directly for bon8 input format with strict=false.

tests.name: cbor_unaffected_strict_false
tests.intent: Probes from_cbor with strict=false to ensure other binary formats are unaffected by BON8 changes.

tests.name: msgpack_unaffected_strict_false
tests.intent: Probes from_msgpack with strict=false to ensure message pack format is unaffected.

tests.name: bon8_span_input_adapter_unterminated_fixed
tests.intent: Probes span_input_adapter directly with from_bon8 on an unterminated string and strict=false.

tests.name: bon8_sax_parse_direct_fixed
tests.intent: Probes basic_json::sax_parse directly for bon8 input format with strict=false.
